terms.comment: obrigado / obrigada — Portuguese “thank you”, from Latin obligātus, obligāta, “obliged”; the form agrees with the speaker.

phrases.latin: Scīsne, Theodōre, quid sit obrigado? Lūsitānī ita grātiās agunt.
phrases.english: Do you know, Theo, what obrigado is? That’s how the Portuguese say thank you.

sources: Lewis & Short: Lusitania · Lewis & Short: obligo
